body.name: rare-component smoothing handle
body.construction: Start from a rare two-component root passed through a separated additive location channel; express \(q(X,\{Y\})\) by posterior classification risk and \(q(Y,\{X\})\) by between-component variance, then replace both root components and the noise by interior-positive compact bump densities and control the two risks and reverse-residual HSIC uniformly in the smoothing radius.
